_comment: Tier-2 for skfem heat#2: conjugate heat transfer across two subdomains. Measured on skfem 12.0.1 (MeshQuad 17x5, with_subdomains fluid/solid, k=1 and k=100): the monolithic assembly shares the interface DOFs, so the interface temperature is single-valued to 1e-15; solving the two regions in isolation with insulated interfaces gives fluid 100.0 and solid 0.0 -- a jump equal to the FULL imposed temperature difference, exactly the O(1) failure the claim describes. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 applies the documented fix inside the isolated loop -- each pass uses the monolithic K assembled over BOTH subdomains and imposes both Dirichlet values, instead of one subdomain's stiffness with the interface left insulated. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1: the unmutated run matches all 4 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 removes 'isolated_interface_jump_is_full_delta_t=True' and 'isolated_jump_over_monolithic_spread_gt_1e12=True' so the fixture goes red. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
